purpose: Cross-market validation of whether a pre-existing Slope/ER/RV regime separates continuation from failure after symmetric MA7 close crosses in the historical Nasdaq-100.

data.universe: point-in-time Nasdaq-100 securities, including historical removals, renamed securities, multiple share classes, and delisted constituents
data.dividends_and_delisting_returns: not included; this is a split-adjusted price-return event study
data.missing_session_policy: fail closed for feature and forward windows; never fill a held or forward return with zero

membership.primary_source_policy: Nasdaq official additions/deletions, reconstitution notices, and corporate-action releases are preferred; a revision-pinned Wikipedia change table is the complete event index and retains row-level citations.
membership.effective_date_semantics: membership changes are effective before the regular-session open on the recorded date unless the source explicitly says the security ceased after the prior close
membership.identifier_policy: resolve point-in-time ticker details and composite/share-class FIGIs at each membership interval; retain explicit ticker lineage and same-symbol entity-generation breaks

event.costs: not applied because this is a close-to-close conditional event study, not an executable strategy backtest

regime.atr14: arithmetic mean of true range over 14 complete regular sessions
regime.rv20: sample standard deviation of 20 daily log returns times sqrt(252)
regime.rv_percentile: within-security percentile rank of RV20[t] among the 252 RV20 observations ending at t

binning.normalized_slope: global pooled quintile edges from all eligible point-in-time member sessions, without reading event outcomes
binning.er20: global pooled quintile edges from all eligible point-in-time member sessions, without reading event outcomes
binning.edge_reuse: MA7 edges are reused unchanged for MA5 and MA10 robustness

statistics.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg within each direction, horizon, and return metric across the 125 three-way cells

market_phase.bull: QQQ close > QQQ SMA200 and QQQ 30-session return > 0
market_phase.bear: QQQ close < QQQ SMA200 and QQQ 30-session return < 0

liquidity_segment.major: top 20 point-in-time member securities on each event session

membership_tenure_segment.recent_member: less than 252 XNAS sessions since the current membership interval began
membership_tenure_segment.seasoned_member: at least 252 XNAS sessions since the current membership interval began

robustness.gap_diagnostic_role: diagnostic only; thresholds cannot select or alter the primary result

cross_market.common_event_date_window_diagnostic: intersect the stock event dates with the min/max event dates in the frozen Binance event artifact; reuse each market's already-frozen regime bins without refitting

decision_boundary.interpretation: A cross-market structure requires economically separated and reasonably monotone or smooth relationships that repeat across time, stock subgroups, MA5/7/10, and gap-excluded diagnostics, with the same directional pattern in the Binance and Nasdaq-100 studies.
